svg.title: Imbokodo Risk and Compliance Workbench: AWS architecture
svg.desc: Three logical tiers: presentation, application and data. Separate paths show authenticated API access, CSV processing, HIGH risk notifications and scheduled reporting. PostgreSQL is the main record. DynamoDB Streams trigger notifications after the database result is saved.
svg.text: Three logical tiers. Four connected cloud paths.
Africa (Cape Town) · af-south-1 · Serverless application with a private data layer
Bad data: quarantine. Repeated technical failures: SQS failure queue (DLQ).
After the PostgreSQL commit. Delivery failure: alert failure queue. Email is not the audit trail.
Main request and event sequences. API, scoring and reporting use private subnets; ingest and alerts run outside the VPC.
